pages.name: Mobzilla
pages.text: Shown at quarter scale. The other three quarters are also coming.

pages.title: The Arena
pages.text: Out in the badlands and deserts stands our colossal Mobzilla Arena — at most one per region, because the region insists. The beast waits inside, and a Waystone by the gate lets your next attempt skip the commute.$(p)The paperwork calls it 'Godzilla'. Survivors call it Mobzilla. Mostly, they just call for help.
Nine buried Mobzilla Parts rebuild its dried egg — in case one arena somehow wasn't enough.

pages.title: The Prize
pages.text: Mobzilla's hoard is absurd: dozens of rolls of top-shelf loot, Ultimate gear among them, plus scales that forge Mobzilla armor to rival the Royal line.$(p)This is intentional. One Mobzilla funds a kingdom — surviving the invoice is the hard part.

pages.title: What They Leave Behind
pages.text: The invoice keeps growing. Every kill drops a key to the arena's $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/vault_heist)ominous vault$() and can shed $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/spell_scrolls)Fire scrolls$(); four scales plate a $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/chitin_band_plating)Traveller's Vest$(), and the hide sews a $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/boss_backpacks)backpack$().$(p)Witches carved its worst day in $(l:orespawn_integrations:world_remembers/mobzilla_statue)stone$() — or summon a fresh one by $(l:orespawn_integrations:world_remembers/summoning_rites)rite$(), thunderstorm required.
